amendments.because: The owner's request and the report need this to hold across fixes and machines, and a teammate's earlier attempts ran on another computer.
amendments.done_when: After a repair fix started from the default branch on this computer, the next sign-off accept counts the earlier round, keeps its settled findings, and stops at round two.

done_when: After a repair fix merges, or after the work moves to another computer, the next sign-off accept counts the earlier rounds, keeps their settled findings, and stops for the owner at round two.

known.title: Preserve sign-off history when close replays a repair

why: Sign-off rounds, settled findings and the owner's stop after round two are lost when a repair fix does not carry the sign-off record from the branch that wrote it. Evidence: _history in src/forge/review.py reads only HEAD's first-parent history of the record; _signoff_review in src/forge/records.py refuses with a repair command that does not say to run it from the sign-off checkout; fix_start in src/forge/task.py stacks on the current branch only when that branch is run from and not yet merged.
